string.text: The anarchists of the Zone. They believe that the Zone is a haven for freedom, and that all the laws, rules and traditions of the outside world do not apply there. Their motto is "Do as you wish and let others do the same." They try to stop the government from placing the Zone under its control, and fight against the Mercs. Freedom fighters use mainly Western and NATO weapons.

A militarized stalkers group who consider it their duty to halt the expansion of the Zone. Focusing on eliminating mutants and destroying artifacts, the clan are in conflict with the "Freedom" faction. Dutyers use mainly Soviet and Russian weapons.
